description: This bar chart illustrates the number of tokens (in thousands, K) associated with various content categories, as part of a study on large language model training for the Sámi language. The horizontal axis, labeled “Categories,” lists the following categories from left to right: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, a blank or missing category (represented by a grey bar), Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis, labeled “Tokens (K),” ranges from 0 to 10,000 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2,000. Each bar is colored light blue and is topped with its exact numerical value in blue text. The tallest bar corresponds to the “Administrative” category with 6,472K tokens, followed by “Science” with 1,626K tokens, “Non-fiction” with 1,889K tokens, “Administrative” with 6,472K tokens, “Religion” with 652K tokens, “Fiction” with 387K tokens, “Law” with 354K tokens, and “Blogs” with 32K tokens. The bar for the missing category is grey and has no value label, indicating it contains no data or was excluded from the analysis. The bars are presented in the order of the categories listed on the x-axis, which is not sorted by value.
